response: Emergency double-balloon enteroscopy (DBE) combined with real-time viewing of capsule endoscopy is a feasible and effective approach in managing acute overt-obscure gastrointestinal bleeding. This combined approach allows for the identification of recurrent bleeding vascular lesions, which may be easily misdiagnosed by non-emergency DBE. DBE itself has been shown to be a safe and accurate method for diagnosing small-bowel disorders, permitting chromoscopy, biopsies, and treatment of lesions. Furthermore, DBE has been found to be equally safe and effective when performed in a community setting as compared to a tertiary referral center. Therefore, the use of emergency DBE combined with real-time capsule endoscopy is a viable option for managing acute gastrointestinal bleeding, potentially avoiding major surgery and providing a successful treatment outcome for most patients.
